units.excerpt: Pre-Existing Diseases - Code Excl 01: expenses related to treatment of a pre-existing disease and direct complications are excluded until expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after inception of the first policy with insurer; portability may reduce the waiting period; enhancement reapplies the exclusion to the increase; post-wait coverage is subject to declaration and insurer acceptance.

reviewed_mapping.reason: Human-approved base PED mechanic from the certified review decision.

applies_to: direct complications of a pre-existing disease
semantic_value.continuity_dependency: 36 months of continuous coverage after inception of the first policy with insurer; portability continuity may reduce the remaining waiting period to the extent of prior coverage
semantic_value.sum_insured_enhancement_rule: The exclusion applies afresh to the extent of any Sum Insured increase.
semantic_value.post_waiting_condition: Coverage after expiry of 36 months remains subject to the pre-existing disease having been declared at application and accepted by the insurer.

units.excerpt: Specified disease/procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02: listed conditions, surgeries and treatments are excluded for 24 months of continuous coverage after inception of the first policy; accident claims are excepted; enhancement reapplies to the increase; the longer waiting period applies when PED also applies; portability may reduce the waiting period.

reviewed_mapping.reason: Human-approved base specified-disease/procedure mechanic from the certified review decision.

exceptions: claims arising due to an accident
semantic_value.continuity_dependency: 24 months of continuous coverage after inception of the first policy with Star Health; portability continuity may reduce the waiting period to the extent of prior coverage.
semantic_value.sum_insured_enhancement_rule: The exclusion applies afresh to the extent of any Sum Insured increase.
semantic_value.interaction_rule: If a listed disease/procedure is also subject to the pre-existing disease waiting period, the longer waiting period applies.
semantic_value.contracted_after_policy_rule: The waiting period applies even if the listed condition is contracted after policy inception or declared and accepted without a specific exclusion.

units.excerpt: 30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03: treatment of illness within 30 days from first policy commencement is excluded except covered accident claims; the exclusion does not apply after more than twelve months of Continuous Coverage; the waiting period applies to enhanced Sum Insured.

reviewed_mapping.reason: Human-approved base initial waiting-period mechanic from the certified review decision.

applies_to: treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date
exceptions: covered claims arising due to an accident
the exclusion does not apply where the insured person has Continuous Coverage for more than twelve months
semantic_value.sum_insured_enhancement_rule: The 30-day waiting period applies to the enhanced Sum Insured when a higher Sum Insured is subsequently granted.
